balance_sheet.credit_rating: CRISIL (in force); Acuité A+ / A1+ upgraded & withdrawn

call_points.text: **Margin outlook:** Management guided maintaining annual EBITDA margin around 38% (+/-2%) and PAT margin of 22% (+/-2%).
**MTF target:** MTF book reached ₹424 Cr in FY26 from ₹239 Cr in FY25, targeted to reach ₹650 Cr in FY27.
**Business mix:** Target is to achieve 70% of business/profitability from client operations and 30% from prop trading in three years.
**RBI prop regulation:** RBI curbs on prop bank limits are mitigated by hybrid broker status, converting intraday limits into bank guarantees.
**uTrade traction:** Algo platform uTrade crossed 5,231 retail clients, though third-party multi-broker rollout faces higher setup costs from SEBI circular.

operating_notes.text: MTF book stood at ₹424 Cr at the end of FY26 vs ₹239 Cr in FY25.
uTrade platform reached 5,231 clients at FY26-end.
Silverleaf merger is in its final leg before NCLT, with approval expected within a quarter.
Acuité upgraded and withdrew ₹2.00 Cr long-term bank loans to ACUITE A+ and ₹949.00 Cr short-term bank loans to ACUITE A1+.
Acuité withdrew ₹68.00 Cr long-term bank loans, ₹150.00 Cr NCDs and ₹381.00 Cr short-term bank loans without assigning any rating.
The company had informed Acuité on May 29, 2026 of its decision not to obtain Acuité ratings going forward, moving to CRISIL.

timeline.summary: Share India Securities announced its Q4/FY26 earnings conference call scheduled for May 20, 2026.
On May 16, 2026, Share India Securities announced that the NSE had reversed a previously levied monetary penalty of ₹1,50,000 for algorithmic order non-tagging.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹415.91 Cr (+73.7% YoY), net profit ₹58.04 Cr (+211.2% YoY).
Board of Directors, led by Vikas Aggarwal, recommended final dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share on May 19, 2026.
Share India Securities Limited held a conference call on May 20, 2026, with analysts and investors to discuss audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4FY26 and FY2026.
Share India held its Q4FY26 concall, guiding ₹650 Cr MTF book in FY27 and detailing plans to shift profit mix to 70% client-driven over 3 years.

Shareholders approved Mr. Arun Kumar Jain (DIN: 07563704) and Mr. Piyush Mahesh Khandelwal (DIN: 06951293) as Non-Executive Independent Directors for five years via postal ballot on May 21, 2026, with 99.99% and 99.44% votes respectively.
NSE levied a ₹2 lakh penalty on Share India Securities for non-compliance related to non-tagging of unique identifiers for algo orders.
Acuité downgraded Share India Securities' bank facilities to ACUITE A4+ on May 29, 2026, citing non-cooperation.
Share India Securities received an NCLT rectification order changing the appointed date of the Silverleaf Capital amalgamation scheme to April 1, 2026.

Acuité upgraded Share India's ₹2 Cr long-term loans to A+ and ₹949 Cr short-term loans to A1+ and withdrew them, withdrawing ₹599 Cr of other facilities unrated, closing its 'Issuer not co-operating' file as CRISIL remains the company's rating agency.
